message: So, the other night, I decided to whip up a fancy dinner. I thought I’d impress the family with my culinary skills — little did I know I was about to be a contestant on a cooking show titled "Who Can Set Off the Smoke Alarm First?" 😅 Let’s just say, the smoke alarm was very enthusiastic about my sautéing skills! After a few rounds of waving a towel and opening windows, I realized we hadn’t practiced our escape plan in ages. It’s a little funny (now), but it reminded me to keep things ready and review our safety plans. Just in case my next gourmet adventure goes up in smoke! What’s your go-to kitchen safety tip?
